fields.name: IntroductionVoiceCall
fields.fieldText:
BDR Sales Process

STEP 1: Introduction                     

“Hi, this is (BDR Name) with Everquote on a recorded line. I was calling to see if (Agent Name) or your office manager might be available?”


Call Purpose

"We are the leading business growth partner in the insurance space and offer a variety of products that

can help you reach your agency goals including data leads, calls, and telemarketing services. I wanted to

check in with you to see if we could help with your business planning"


If NOT available and you get Voicemail

“Hi, this is _____ with EverQuote. We are the leading business growth partner in the insurance space and

offer a variety of products that can help you reach your agency goals including data leads, calls, and

telemarketing services. I wanted to check in with you to see if we could help with your business planning. If

you’d like further information on what we are offering to help agents write more business you can reach

me at ___ or book some time with me on the email I’ve just sent over– Have a good day!”

★ After leaving your message always send a follow up email


If GK transfers you to a DM

“Hi, this is ___ on a recorded line with EverQuote. We are the leading business growth partner in the

insurance space and offer a variety of products that can help you reach your agency goals including data

leads, calls, and telemarketing services. I wanted to check in with you to see if we could help with your

business planning- are you currently using leads, transfers, or other marketing strategies at your agency?”


If YES

“Great, how is that working for you?”

(Get a specific answer, like what is their closing ratio)

Possible talk tracks to get the agent to open up..

→ “is there anything you’d ideally like to see your vendor perform better in?

→ “Is it worth seeing if we could get you a better return on your investment?”

If NO

“I see, is there a reason you have stepped away from leads?”

“Are you looking to write more business?”

(We want to figure out their past issues with leads or if they fit their current structure)

→ if staffing related set-up a time to follow-up

→ if they have a large BOB set-up a time to follow-up in the distant future

If the agent says “send me an email”

“What would you like this email to include?”

→We DO NOT send pricing emails– we need a discovery

(Pricing is tailored based on agency structure and needs)



STEP 2: Discovery

fields.name: Step4
fields.fieldText:
STEP 4: Make Transfer/Meeting  

If the DM is ready to be transferred right away:

Use the Transfer Queue (based on carrier) 


Introduce the ISR to the Agency Owner/DM


“Hi (ISR), I have (DM) on the phone and they are interested in hearing more about “X” products and services. They have “X” number of advisors and are looking at getting “X” number of leads per day. They are only licensed in one state and are open to taking leads/transfers in the entire state. Are you ready for the transfer?” 


(Bring the agent on the line and introduce them to your sales rep) ﻿


“Hey (DM) I have (ISR) on the line. They will be able to help you with any of your questions from this point. Don't

forget to ask them about our Lead Connection Service or Consumer Initiated Calls as those products might be

great for you! Take care.”


”If the DM wants the meeting at a later date: 

“No problem. It looks like a specialist has availability later today, does that work for you? If not, how about tomorrow morning?” 


(Once they have agreed to a meeting time)


“Great, I have a meeting set with (ISR) at (time and date of meeting). Don't forget to ask about our lead connection

service or consumer initiated calls during your meeting as those products might be a great fit for your agency!

Please let me know if you have any questions before then and thank you so much for your time today.”

★ You should always try to schedule a meeting the same day or the next day. If that doesn’t work for

the agent, you can schedule at most 2 weeks out. Please contact your manager if you need

anything scheduled further out than that.
